import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    p = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))

    # The operation transforms a decreasing triple (a,b,c) into (c,b,a),
    # which is exactly one adjacent swap of a and b plus one adjacent swap of b and c.
    # Hence inversion parity is preserved.
    #
    # Also, every allowed move strictly decreases the inversion count by 2,
    # so the sorted permutation is reachable iff the initial inversion count is even.

    inv_parity = 0
    for i in range(n):
        pi = p[i]
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if pi > p[j]:
                inv_parity ^= 1

    print("YES" if inv_parity == 0 else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
